description: Return type of coarse_filter: survivors plus the auditable per-reason rejection tally.
docstring:
Outcome of one coarse_filter application.

Attributes:
    candidates: Surviving rows, same columns as the input catalog frame.
    total_input: Row count of the catalog frame before filtering.
    rejected_by_reason: Maps each rejection reason string to a count; keys always present for every reason in the acquisition module's rejection-reason vocabulary (including publisher_blocklisted), value 0 if that reason excluded nothing.
    criteria: The exact CoarseFilterCriteria applied, retained for the funnel_report analysis_results entry so a past run's exact band is reconstructable without re-reading parameters.toml.

edge_cases.input: A rejection reason that excluded zero rows in this run
edge_cases.expected_behavior: still present in rejected_by_reason with value 0, per coarse_filter's own postcondition, so an overly broad blocklist entry silently removing nothing is still visible rather than absent from the report

unit_tests.name: test_counts_are_internally_consistent
unit_tests.description: For any FunnelResult produced by coarse_filter's own tests, len(candidates)+sum(rejected_by_reason.values()) equals total_input.
